verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a natural-language AI chatbot that queries, summarizes and explains CRM records. It also documents AI agents that run multi-step tasks such as enriching records, within the user's permission model. The chat evidence covers retrieval more than operation, though: it does not show that users can broadly operate the product by command, such as creating or editing records, changing views or configuring workflows. missing for 10: documented natural-language write/configuration actions across the product, hands-on or independent corroboration of command-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask questions about your data in natural language. The AI chatbot can query your CRM records, summarize information, and help you find what you're looking for without building complex filters.
Ask questions in natural language and the assistant retrieves and explains your CRM data for you.
AI agents that work autonomously within your CRM — answering questions, enriching records, and executing multi-step tasks within your permission model.
AI agents go beyond chat — they can execute multi-step tasks autonomously: Enrich records with data from external sources
Let an agent generate documents from a chat, using your tool.
